## Activity

During May 2019, Hill Counties Health Centre completed 84 captures. This provides the activity record for the reporting month and confirms that image capture was undertaken at the site. The recorded volume should be reviewed alongside the image-quality and grading outcomes below.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 6 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 7.1 per cent. These results should be considered when reviewing the reliability of the imaging process and identifying any operational issues affecting image quality. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be monitored and addressed through the appropriate support process.

## Grading

There were 6 referable results during May 2019. The median grading wait was 4. The grading outcome should be considered with the recorded activity and image-quality measures to support routine site monitoring. Any required follow-up should be managed through the established clinical and operational arrangements at Hill Counties Health Centre.
